lines: Sheetal chanda
Sheetal chanda
Agni ban gaye, kaante ban gaye phool
couplets.en: The cool moon turned to fire, and the flowers to thorns.

lines: Pyaar na karna tu kisi se
Pyaar hai mann ki bhool
couplets.en: Give your heart to no one, for love is the heart's mistake.

lines: Mujhe tum nazar se gira to rahe ho
couplets.en: I may be falling in your esteem.

lines: Mujhe tum nazar se gira to rahe ho
Mujhe tum kabhi bhi bhula na sakoge
couplets.en: I may be falling in your esteem, but you will never forget me.

lines: Na jaane mujhe kyun yaqeen ho chala hai
couplets.en: I wonder why I am growing so certain.

lines: Na jaane mujhe kyun yaqeen ho chala hai
Mere pyaar ko tum mita na sakoge
couplets.en: Somehow I have come to believe you will never erase my love.

lines: Mujhe tum nazar se
couplets.en: I am falling from your sight.

lines: Meri yaad hogi
Kabhi ban ke aansoo, kabhi naghma ban ke
couplets.en: I will return as a tear, or sometimes as a song.

lines: Meri yaad hogi jidhar jaoge tum
Kabhi naghma ban ke, kabhi ban ke aansoo
couplets.en: Wherever you go, my memory will find you, sometimes as a song and sometimes as a tear.

lines: Tadapta mujhe har taraf paoge tum
Shama jo jalayi hai meri wafa ne, bujhana bhi chaho, bujha na sakoge
couplets.en: Everywhere you will find me in anguish, and even if you try, you cannot put out the flame my devotion lit.

lines: Mujhe tum nazar se
couplets.en: I am falling from your sight.

lines: Kabhi naam baaton mein aaya jo mera
To bechain ho ke dil thaam loge
couplets.en: If my name comes up in conversation, your heart will stir and you will clutch it.

lines: To bechain ho ke dil thaam loge
couplets.en: Your heart will stir and you will clutch it.

lines: Kabhi naam baaton mein aaya jo mera
couplets.en: If ever my name comes up in conversation.

lines: To bechain ho ke
Batana bhi chaho, bata na sakoge
Mujhe tum nazar se
couplets.en: Even if you want to speak, the words will fail you as I fall from your sight.
